title: Individual Household Electric Power Consumption
citation: Hebrail, G. & Berard, A. (2006). Individual Household Electric Power Consumption [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C58K54
transformations: Parsed the published one-minute Date, Time and Global_active_power fields.
Skipped source rows whose published active-power value is missing.
Aggregated valid observations into five-minute buckets using the arithmetic mean.
Renamed the measured global active power value to load_kw; no interpolation or synthetic rows were added.
scope_notice: This is real household power data used as a large public algorithm benchmark. It is not port, terminal, AGV or production data.
